hero.question: what is it?
hero.title: Five readings on the cameras you already have.
hero.text: Fire and smoke, PPE by body region, ergonomics, risk zones and counting: one verdict per event, with its evidence clip. Pick a reading.

epi.title: PPE with three states
epi.text: If the camera can't see a body region, the verdict is undetermined. No guessing.

states.ok: PPE is present on the checked region.
states.alert: PPE is missing on the checked region.
states.warn: The region isn't visible enough to decide.

epi.explain: When a region leaves the frame, its verdict is undetermined. Nothing fires.
epi.legend: Pick a pose to watch each region leave the frame.

meta.title: Privacy — how Recognition handles personal data under LGPD
meta.description: Physical signage, controller and processor roles set by contract, presence-based detection and defined evidence retention.

hero.question: how do we handle data?
hero.title: Privacy by design.
hero.text: Recognition is built to support compliance with Brazil's LGPD inside the plant.

signage.title: Physical signage
signage.text: Signs tell people the area is monitored and why.

roles.title: Roles set by contract
roles.text: The customer is the controller. Logikos acts as processor, within the contract.

presence.title: Presence, not identity
presence.text: The system detects presence, posture and PPE. It watches the condition; it does not identify who the person is.

retention.title: Defined retention
retention.text: How long evidence is kept is set by contract. After that, the clip is deleted.

compliance.note: This summary does not replace the contract or the legal review of each installation.

meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: How Logikos Soluções handles personal data sent through this website.

hero.question: what do we do with your data?
hero.title: Privacy policy
hero.text: Provisional version. Final text under legal review.

controller.title: Who handles your data
controller.text: Logikos Soluções, CNPJ {cnpj}, based in Indaial, Santa Catarina, Brazil, is the controller of the data sent through this website.

data.title: What we collect
data.text: Name, company, role, email, WhatsApp number, interests and the message you write in the form, plus technical data about the submission: IP address (used only for the anti-abuse check), page, language, date and time. This website uses no tracking or advertising cookies.

purpose.title: Why we use it
purpose.text: To answer your inquiry and follow up on the conversation you asked for.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis
legalBasis.text: Consent, recorded when you send the form (Brazil's LGPD, art. 7, I). Final basis under legal review.

sharing.title: Who we share it with
sharing.text: With Cloudflare, which hosts this website, stores inquiries and runs the anti-abuse check, acting as processor. Data may be processed outside Brazil, with the safeguards of LGPD art. 33. We do not sell data.

antiAbuse.title: Abuse protection
antiAbuse.text: The form uses Cloudflare Turnstile to tell people from bots. Turnstile receives technical browser signals and your IP address, only for that check.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.text: For as long as the conversation lasts and for any period the law requires. Final term to be set.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can ask for confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization, blocking or deletion, portability and information about sharing, and withdraw consent at any time (LGPD, art. 18). You can also petition Brazil's data protection authority (ANPD).

contact.title: How to reach us
contact.text: By email at {email}. Data protection officer: to be appointed.

form.name: Name
form.consentAfter: and agree to the use of this data to reply to me.

fire.title: Fire and smoke detection
fire.text: Smoke and flame flagged in the video, with a clip of the moment.
fire.fires: Smoke or flame in the frame.
fire.receives: Clip of the moment, marked frame and an immediate alert.
fire.not: Doesn't wait for a ceiling sensor: it reads the video.

epi.title: PPE by body region
epi.text: Every region gets a verdict: compliant, non-compliant or undetermined.
epi.fires: A visible body region without the required PPE.
epi.receives: A verdict per region, with the marked frame.
epi.not: An occluded region is undetermined: no alarm.

ergonomics.title: Ergonomics
ergonomics.text: Risky postures and time spent in each one.
ergonomics.receives: Time in each posture and the clip.
ergonomics.not: Does not identify who the person is.

zones.title: Hazard zones
zones.text: Entry into marked areas and time spent inside.
zones.receives: Dwell time and the marked frame.
zones.not: Blocks nothing: it tells whoever decides.

counting.title: Counting
counting.text: Crossings over a line or through an area.
counting.fires: A crossing over a line or through an area.
counting.not: Doesn't count people by face: it counts crossings.

epi.title: PPE demo
epi.see: People and objects marked in real time, with the box and the chip.
epi.verdict: The chip says what was detected. Compliant, non-compliant and undetermined only appear in the product, with body regions.
epi.note: A generic detection demo. Not the plant's PPE model.

fire.title: Fire and smoke demo
fire.see: Flame and smoke marked on your device camera.
fire.verdict: An alert when the model sees flame or smoke. The demo page publishes its measured false-alarm rate.
fire.note: A model trained only on public, permissively licensed data.

demos.browser: The model runs in your browser. Nothing is sent.

note.title: What these demos are not.
note.text: They are open models running on your device, so you can watch a verdict happen. The product runs in the plant, on your cameras, with all five readings.

meta.title: Platform — Edge and Cloud
meta.description: Two ways to run Recognition: a device in the plant, no internet needed, term license; or the cloud platform on a monthly plan, with dashboard and evidence. No public pricing.

hero.question: edge or cloud?
hero.title: In the plant or in the cloud. The same verdict, with evidence.
hero.text: Edge: a device in the rack, works without internet, term licence. Cloud: a panel in the browser, monthly fee.
